one_line: A confession line that withholds the object, then real use in a real place and one honest drawback.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down: two hands smooth a closed navy zipped pouch on an airplane tray table. A song plays (transcript lyrics), no speech. Text, two lines: "קניתי משהו מטומטם ועכשיו אני לא טסה בלעדיו".
q1_hook.why: A confession states an outcome, "I don't fly without it", and withholds what the object is, a gap that 0:03 answers (H5, H2). The product is in hands from the first frame (S1) in a real, relatable place (H8). There is no face or voice, but there is a song (H4, H6).

beats.what: Hands smooth a closed navy pouch on a tray table; confession text
beats.why: A withheld object and a strong verdict

beats.what: The pouch opens and chargers go in; "זה נרתיק לכבלים שאצלי מחזיק 2 מטענים לטלפון ואחד למקבוק"
beats.why: Answers the gap and states the capacity

beats.what: "אבל במקום מטען למחשב אפשר גם לשים מטען נייד", then "בהתחלה התבאסתי שזה קטן..."; link note 0:08
beats.why: An honest drawback makes the praise credible

beats.what: The pouch is closed and lifted; "וזה עושה לי סדר בתיק"
beats.why: Closes on the benefit and the link note

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen from 0:08: "לינק בתיאור". Caption: follow, and comment "נרתיק" to get the link by message; also a link, a search code and two discount codes.
q2_flow.why: A new text card every 2 to 3 s, each tied to what the hands do, keeps a 12 s Reel clear (R3, R2). The answer to the opening gap comes at 0:03 (H5), and an honest drawback adds trust (K4). The Reel ends right on the benefit line (R1, E8).

q3_cta.what: On screen from 0:08 to the end: "לינק בתיאור". Not said. Caption: "כדי לקבל את הלינק: 1. עקבו אחרי ... 2. כתבו ״נרתיק״ ואשלח לכם את הלינק", plus a link, the search code AYV5NQ and two discount codes.
q3_cta.why: A keyword that delivers a real link is a purposeful ask (C3, C2, R6), and the on-screen reminder comes after the demo (C6). But the video says "link in the description", not the comment word, and the caption stacks follow, comment, link, code and coupons (against C1).

q4_shown.what: A navy zipped pouch on a plane tray table 0:00-0:02; it opens and two phone chargers and a laptop charger go in 0:03-0:09; she closes and lifts it 0:10-0:11. Other passengers and a tablet are visible behind. No price, brand or size reference.
q4_shown.why: Hands handle the product from 0:00 (S1, S4). Real use on a plane is credible proof, and the "at first I was disappointed it's small" line is a first-hand verdict, not an adjective (S6). Nothing shows its size against a known object.

q5_edit.what: 2 shots in 12.4 s with one cut at about 3 s; handheld; the second shot is one continuous take. Five large white outlined text cards change every 2 to 3 s. No speech; a song under it. Ends as she lifts the closed pouch.
q5_edit.why: A short Reel with a new card every 2 to 3 s, each synced to the hands, is clear and sound-off friendly (T1, T2, R2). One take after the first cut is fine at 12 s (E2, R1). The shake and moving passengers behind distract (F7).

q6_topic.what: A cable pouch bought online that keeps a family's chargers in order on a flight; it serves parents who travel with kids and carry many devices.
q6_topic.why: A practical parent need, many chargers for a family of five (K6), told as a confession with an honest drawback (K4, S6) rather than a pitch. It is a tip a parent could send to a travelling friend (R5). The mood is matter-of-fact, with no high peak (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld top-down shots over an airplane tray table, cabin light, a shaky frame; a passenger with a tablet and other people's legs and seats visible behind; no face of the creator.
q7_filmed.why: A real aircraft seat is the proof of use (H8) and top-down hands show how the pouch opens (F5, S4). The shake and strangers behind distract, and the open pouch is small and cluttered with cables at 0:03-0:09 (F7, F4).

q8_text.on_screen: White bold text, dark outline, 2 to 3 lines, centred about 60 to 75 percent down: "קניתי משהו מטומטם ועכשיו אני לא טסה בלעדיו" (0:00-0:02); "זה נרתיק לכבלים שאצלי מחזיק 2 מטענים לטלפון ואחד למקבוק" (0:03-0:05); "אבל במקום מטען למחשב אפשר גם לשים מטען נייד" (0:06-0:07); "בהתחלה התבאסתי שזה קטן אבל זה מחזיק המון" (0:08-0:09); "וזה עושה לי סדר בתיק" (0:10-0:11); "לינק בתיאור" below, about 83 percent down, from 0:08.
q8_text.caption: "אני לא בטוחה למה קניתי את זה, אבל עכשיו אני לא טסה בלעדיו." About 179 words: a story, capacity, an honest drawback, a two-step ask (follow, comment "נרתיק"), a link, a search code, two discount codes, 5 hashtags. No disclosure wording.
q8_text.why: The first card is a clear hook and each card is a short phrase synced to the action (T3, T2), so it works muted (T1). The cards sit partly in the bottom 35% (T4). The caption opens with the confession and product words (T7), but the affiliate link and codes carry no disclosure (T8).

weak_points: A shaky handheld frame with strangers behind; the open pouch small and cluttered; the video says "link in the description" while the caption asks for a follow, a comment word, a link and two codes; no affiliate disclosure.
lumebook_takeaway: Film hands using the book in a real place with one honest confession line first, one drawback line, and one comment word. Keep it near 12 s.
not_verified: Music: the transcript is song lyrics, so a song plays; its source and licence are unknown. Whether the creator earns a commission (the caption has an affiliate link and codes). The product's price and size. No corrections to the first pass.
